Experience behind

Let’s discuss your production

The company behind the work

A steady hand.
A wider perspective.

Ready To Go Productions is Frank Scudero’s established, active production company. Approximately 30 years directing live television inform the work: preparation, timing, anticipation and the ability to stay calm as events unfold.

That experience extends to interviews, television-style productions, special events, weddings and broader production projects. We start by understanding what you need to communicate, then talk through the right approach.

What we can create together.

Live & special events

Production shaped around the people, pace and purpose of the event.

Interviews & commercial projects

Clear conversations and purposeful images for the message you want to share.

Television-style production

Live-production experience applied to the way a program comes together.

A personal connection

The experience GioLina grew from.

GioLina Films was created from the experience behind Ready To Go Productions as a dedicated boutique wedding brand for cinematography and photography. Ready To Go continues the broader production work, with that same care behind the camera.
